note: All four candidate architecture-induced-failure pairs come from the audit brief, not from workspace artifacts. No trajectories, ablations, or counterfactual runs exist here, so every classification below is UNRESOLVED at the evidence level; the column records the hypothesis and the experiment that would decide it.

cases.pair: per-cell stochastic formula synthesis -> ProgramGroup translation fixes inconsistency
cases.proposed_reading: old architecture synthesized each cell stochastically, creating inconsistency that translation then repaired
cases.why_unresolved: no synthesis logs, no per-cell vs grouped comparison in workspace
cases.deciding_experiment: ablate: grouped-mechanical-fill vs per-cell synthesis holding the canonical formula fixed; if inconsistency vanishes when the agent writes one Python loop, the failure was architecture-induced
cases.if_architecture_induced: translation keeps only an efficiency/reliability role, not a capability role

cases.pair: isolated target execution -> dependency closure fixes composition
cases.proposed_reading: executing isolated targets created composition breaks that closure repaired
cases.why_unresolved: no execution-unit definitions, closure logs, or composition-failure corpus in workspace
cases.deciding_experiment: compare loose-agent full-sheet edits (no units) vs isolated-unit edits on composition-error rate; if loose agent rarely breaks composition, closure-as-repair was architecture-induced and only closure-as-warning survives
cases.if_architecture_induced: drop auto-expanding closure; keep advisory affected-cell preview

cases.pair: large auto-serialized grounding/evidence packets -> compact/SQL working-set machinery reduces replay
cases.proposed_reading: push-model grounding created the context bloat that working sets then reduced
cases.why_unresolved: no packet samples, token counts, or replay measurements in workspace
cases.deciding_experiment: push (auto packets) vs pull (on-demand queries) vs raw agent-Python on context cost at equal capability; if pull/raw matches push on capability at lower cost, the working-set win was repair of a self-inflicted wound
cases.if_architecture_induced: dissolve push grounding; keep only on-demand completeness primitives

cases.pair: generated authority -> closure must intersect with authority to remain safe
cases.proposed_reading: harness-generated authority created the overreach risk that intersection logic then contained
cases.why_unresolved: no authority specifications or overreach incidents in workspace
cases.deciding_experiment: remove generated authority entirely (agent-named scope only) and measure over-write rate; if overreach disappears, intersection machinery was patching its own generator
cases.if_architecture_induced: authority expansion dies; only L4 scope validation of agent-declared intent remains
